Name: Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria
Summary: Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria, also called Pul, took tribute from Menahem, stripped Israel's northern cities under Pekah, took Damascus and slew Rezin, and received Ahaz's appeal and temple treasure.
KeyStory: Tiglath-Pileser, called Pul, strips Israel's north and takes Damascus.
RelatedPeople: Menahem, King of Israel; Pekah, King of Israel; Rezin, King of Syria; Ahaz, King of Judah
LifeLesson: The king Ahaz bought became the king who owned him.
